decisions.owner_resolution: Explicit root authorization in chain-intersection74/application/reader76-observation-preservation.json preserves the native finding and authenticates a separate complete before-carrier. I independently reviewed that archive and the current finite-chain repair; the original observed item/contract/manifest composite is unavailable, so historical composite uncertainty remains.
decisions.evidence: Historical Proof1.1 applies general position/intersection to an arbitrary rational singular three-chain without defining its intersection product or supplying relative smoothing. The archived oriented-intersection definition covers smooth maps/manifolds only. Current Proof1.1 explicitly supplies finite labeled face-closed smoothing relative to collars, independent factors, facewise diagonal transversality, compact oriented one-dimensional preimages and cancellation of rational internal faces, plus replacement independence. Proof1.2 adds the product collar and computes the outward-normal-first sign. Checked Guillemin-Pollack printed68-73,107-114 in the archived primary text and the full published relative-simplex smoothing lemma; full AC covers its countable-choice assumption. Reviewed current producer contract/manifest and actual downstream TOP hypersurface/metabolizer proofs. Current supplier supports thm-locally-flat-slice-implies-fox-milnor-factorization; no outside edit was made. See the accompanying report for reading limits and preserved nonfatal owner-maintenance alert.
